paragraphs: Baker, look at this list: honor your leaders, live in peace, be patient with EVERYONE, never repay evil for evil. Read it all in one sitting and you'll want to lie down on the cooling rack. Here's the big idea: this is not a list for a lone hero, but for a church, a family of believers carrying one another. The writers say to "admonish the unruly, encourage the fainthearted, help the weak, and be patient with everyone" (1 Thessalonians 5:14).

Now here's the part I love, friend: right when the list gets heavy, the letter says, "Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely" (1 Thessalonians 5:23). Himself, not a committee and not a motivational poster! Then comes the line that holds up the whole batch: "The One who calls you is faithful, and He will do it" (1 Thessalonians 5:24). I spent years in a junk drawer thinking I was finished, and the One who called me out made me new, and the same goes for you.

So how do you live out a list this big? You lean on the One who calls you, and you lean on each other. Rejoice, pray, give thanks, test what you hear, hold fast to what is good, and pray for the people who teach you, just like the writers ask in "Brothers, pray for us as well" (1 Thessalonians 5:25). You won't do it perfectly today, and that's okay, because the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ is with you (1 Thessalonians 5:28), so keep your ovens ready, baker, and let Him do the finishing.
